name: context_compressor_append_text_to_content
notes: Content append/prepend helper (context_compressor_ports.c::cc_append_text_to_content vs LIVE agent/context_compressor.py::_append_text_to_content). Inputs are tab-separated <content_json>\t<text>\t<prepend>. EXCLUDED DIVERGENCES: JSON "[]" and "\"\"" hit the C port's empty-sentinel branch (B1) but take LIVE's list/string branches, so those encodings of empty containers are not exercised; non-JSON-scalars (e.g. int content encoded without quotes) return unchanged in C but str()+concat in LIVE.
